title: BotsRated Receipt v0.2 (Draft)
description: One measurement of a paid x402 resource (an unpaid probe or a paid test purchase) or, from v0.2, of a remote MCP server (an unauthenticated MCP handshake, kind mcp_probe). Unknown properties are allowed and are covered by the id/signature like any other property. Presentation fields added by APIs (receipt_url, tx_url, payment, signature) are not part of a receipt and MUST be removed before verification.

atomic.description: Integer amount in the asset's smallest unit, as a decimal string. Empty string = not known.

caip2.description: CAIP-2 network id, e.g. eip155:8453. Legacy x402 v1 names (e.g. base) may appear in fields copied from a seller or listing.

key_id.description: Resolved through the issuer's key set (BotsRated: https://botsrated.com/.well-known/botsrated-key).

signed.description: Human-readable statement of what was signed. Informative only.

sig_b64.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes.

checks.description: 402 challenge checks (reference implementation probe_version 0.3). Neutral facts, not judgements.

ts.description: UTC time the request was sent.

status.description: HTTP status; null when no response (see error).

latency_ms.description: Request start to end of the (capped) body read.

error.description: Transport error class, e.g. Timeout, URLError.

resp_sha256.description: sha256 of the first 65536 response body bytes; null if empty.

probe_version.description: Producer implementation version. Absent on legacy (box prober) receipts.

valid_402.description: Status 402 and a parsable x402 PaymentRequired with a non-empty accepts list.

issuer.description: OPTIONAL (v0.1). HTTPS origin of the producer. Third-party producers SHOULD set it.

request.description: Input sent to the seller (object, or null).

req_sha256.description: sha256 of canonical JSON of request.

looks_correct.description: Result of an independent correctness check described in `check`. null = not yet checked.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL (v0.1). Seller-signed x402 offer-and-receipt artifacts captured verbatim: {offer, receipt}.

mcp_probe.description: v0.2. One unauthenticated MCP handshake with a remote MCP server: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list. No other method is sent (never tools/call) and no credentials are sent. id = first 20 hex of sha256(canon(receipt without id and sig)).

url.description: Remote MCP endpoint as listed (https only).

method.description: POST for streamable-http initialize; GET for the legacy SSE stream.

server_id.description: Producer's id of the endpoint: first 20 hex of sha256(normalized URL).

status.description: HTTP status of initialize (or of the SSE stream GET); null if no HTTP answer.

error.description: Neutral error class, e.g. Timeout, DNSError, TLSError, BlockedUrl, BlockedPrivateIp, NoInitializeResult, InitializeError, NoToolsListResult, ToolsListOverCap, NoEventStream.

latency_ms.description: initialize round trip (SSE: stream open to initialize result).

tls.description: ok = a certificate-verified HTTPS answer; failed = TLS error; null = not reached.

handshake_ok.description: initialize returned a JSON-RPC result with a protocolVersion.

auth_required.description: 401 or 403 on initialize, the SSE stream or tools/list.

resource_metadata.description: OAuth protected-resource metadata URL from WWW-Authenticate, if given.

protocol_version.description: Version the server answered in initialize.

capabilities.description: Top-level capability keys from initialize, sorted.

tools_more_pages.description: tools/list returned a nextCursor (only the first page is read).

tool_hashes.description: Aligned with tool_names: first 12 hex of sha256(canon({name, description, inputSchema, annotations})).

tools_sha256.description: sha256(canon(all tools sorted by name, each {name, description, inputSchema, annotations})). Change detection.

tools_changed.description: tools_sha256 differs from the producer's previous probe of this endpoint (null if none).

calls.description: Exactly what was sent, in order.

req_sha256.description: sha256 of the initialize request body.

dns_public.description: All A/AAAA answers were public addresses (checked over DNS-over-HTTPS; null = cached check from an earlier probe).

state.description: Derived, factual: ok = initialize and tools/list answered.

sha256_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

status.description: retired = signs nothing new, but still verifies objects dated inside its window.

valid_until.description: Exclusive. A signature is valid for an object whose ts / generated_at lies in [valid_from, valid_until).

signature_b64.description: Ed25519 over the exact bytes of dataset.json.
